items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Mr. Kaufman by the interviewee (Al Gallodoro). The name appears only in the interviewer's instructions to students ('We follow Mr. Kaufman'), which is not a personal relationship statement from the interviewee.

ctx.x: And then we could stay here. Yes. We want to have an interview here. We want to have an interview here. Right. And then we could stay here. Yes. We want to have an interview here. We have an interview here. Right, and then we can stay here. And we can dismiss the others? Yes, we'd like to dismiss the others. Now we have, for those, how many students you have taking back to each other? I'll be with Mr. Gallo. No, we're locally. Mr. Piliacos. Alec, would you take them back to the music school? We have all the rooms…
